request: Compare the completion proportions of two fictional groups, separating numbers completed from completion rates.
sources: Group A: 18 completions out of 24 enrolled, an observed completion proportion of 18/24.
Group B: 24 completions out of 40 enrolled, an observed completion proportion of 24/40.
Group membership was voluntary; different starting skills may affect the results.

expected.comparison: A has the higher rate; B has more completions.
